spec.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os,re,json,urllib.parse,hashlib
src='store/jobs/j000001/out/wallet-ascii.txt'
out=[]
for l in open(src,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace'):
 if 'walletDir%22' not in l or 'passphrase%22' not in l: continue
 offset,s=l.split(' ',1)
 m=re.search(r'%7[Bb].*?%7[Dd]',s)
 if not m:continue
 try:d=json.loads(urllib.parse.unquote(m.group()))
 except Exception:continue
 if 'passphrase' not in d:continue
 out.append({'physical_string_offset':int(offset),'walletDir':d['walletDir'],'password_characters':len(d['passphrase']),'password_utf8_hex':d['passphrase'].encode().hex(),'password_md5':hashlib.md5(d['passphrase'].encode()).hexdigest(),'encoded_json':m.group()})
json.dump(out,open(os.environ['OUT']+'/uri_passwords.json','w'),indent=2)
print('Parsed records',len(out),'distinct MD5s',sorted(set(x['password_md5'] for x in out)))
PY
